name: Desiderio (TYPO3 14)
install:
composer install --no-interaction --no-progress
npm ci
Build/CiApp/bootstrap.sh
(cd Build/CiApp && npm ci && npm run build)

terminals.name: typo3
terminals.command: cd Build/CiApp && TYPO3_CONTEXT=Production php -d memory_limit=768M -d opcache.enable=0 -d opcache.enable_cli=0 -S 127.0.0.1:8080 -t public
terminals.description: Serves the disposable Desiderio QA TYPO3 site (seeded SQLite app, 263 elements) at http://127.0.0.1:8080/. Backend login at /typo3/ (admin / Qa!Harness2026). Element preview URLs: vendor/bin/typo3 desiderio:library:urls --site=main --json
